russiaReachability.endpointQuorumPolicy: Check-Host: at least 2 positive responses from currently operational ru1/ru2/ru3 nodes (2/2 or 2/3). Globalping fallback: 2 positive responses from 3 dynamically selected live Russian locations.
russiaReachability.policy: Russia Gate is shared by regular and LTE/whitelist candidates. It selects the operational subset of ru1/ru2/ru3 by canary evidence and requires two positive Check-Host responses (2/2 or 2/3). Only when Check-Host infrastructure or an endpoint result is unavailable/inconclusive does the Russia Gate use Globalping as a 2/3 fallback across three dynamically selected live Russian locations. After Russia Gate, LTE/whitelist candidates undergo exact-link Xray validation (with a bounded Cloudflare download fallback) and no additional Globalping pass. Regular servers continue through the existing local TCP + Xray + HTTPS diagnostics + independent multi-provider speed + gaming pipeline.

quarantine.policy: failed endpoints are hidden from the active subscription immediately, but are not permanently blacklisted and may return after a later successful health check
